description: This PHP class represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for Skills associated with an employee. It provides methods to convert skill data to an array format and maps class properties to entity getter methods. It is used within a human resource management system for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing an employee's skill within the HR system, capable of serializing skill data and defining field mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Skill DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's skills to an array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods in the Employee entity.
